claims.claim: 速效救心丸由川芎（Ligusticum striatum，Chuanxiong Rhizoma）与冰片（Dryobalanops aromatica，Borneolum syntheticum/合成冰片）两味组成；据《中国药典》质量标准，每丸含川芎（以阿魏酸计）不低于 15.0 μg、含合成冰片（以龙脑计）2.9–4.4 mg。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy and Safety of Suxiao Jiuxin Pills in the Treatment of Chronic Coronary Syndrome with Intolerance to Adverse Effects of Long-acting Nitrates (BMC Complement Med Ther, 2024)
claims.supportQuote: The pill is composed of Ligusticum striatum DC. … Chuanxiong Rhizoma … and Dryobalanops aromatica C.F.Gaertn. … Borneolum syntheticum … According to the Chinese Pharmacopoeia, each pill of SJPs is required to contain a minimum of 15.0 μg of Ligusticum chuanxiong, expressed in terms of ferulic acid … and 2.9 to 4.4 mg of Borneolum syntheticum, expressed in terms of Borneol.
claims.applicability: 直接适用于本品组分与质量标准的描述。
claims.uncertainty: 冰片为合成冰片（Borneolum syntheticum），与天然冰片在安全性上可能有差异。

claims.claim: 速效救心丸为川芎嗪（tetramethylpyrazine）与冰片组成的制剂，国家药监局批准文号 Z12020025，每丸重 40 mg。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy and safety of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill in the treatment of stable angina (Qi stagnation and blood stasis syndrome): study protocol (Trials, 2021)
claims.supportQuote: SJP is composed of tetramethylpyrazine and borneol approval number Z12020025 of the China State Food and Drug Administration … Each pill weighs 40 mg.
claims.applicability: 直接适用于本品组分与制剂规格的描述。
claims.uncertainty: 批准文号表述来自试验方案，官方现行说明书规格须再核。

claims.claim: 一项多中心、随机、双盲、安慰剂对照试验设计纳入 324 例慢性稳定型心绞痛（气滞血瘀证）患者，给予速效救心丸或安慰剂 5 粒/次、每日 3 次，在常规治疗基础上用药 24 周。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy and safety of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill in the treatment of stable angina (Qi stagnation and blood stasis syndrome): study protocol (Trials, 2021)
claims.supportQuote: The trial will enroll 324 participants with chronic stable angina (Qi Stagnation and Blood Stasis syndrome) … Eligible participants will receive either SJP or placebo (five pills administered orally, three times daily) in addition to conventional treatment for 24 weeks.
claims.applicability: 直接覆盖「连续用药 ≥3 个月（24 周）」的稳定型心绞痛辅助治疗场景。
claims.uncertainty: 此为试验方案（protocol），非最终结果；正式结果见 Sun 等 2024 年发表的该试验报告。

claims.claim: 该 24 周试验的主要结局为心绞痛疗效及复合心血管事件（心源性死亡、非致死性心肌梗死、经皮冠脉介入或冠脉搭桥血运重建、心力衰竭、冠心病住院）。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy and safety of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill in the treatment of stable angina (Qi stagnation and blood stasis syndrome): study protocol (Trials, 2021)
claims.supportQuote: The primary outcome is the effect in angina pectoris, a composite endpoint of cardiovascular events (cardiac death, nonfatal myocardial infarction, revascularization with PCI or coronary artery bypass graft, heart failure, and hospitalization for coronary heart disease).
claims.applicability: 说明该长期试验同时观察心血管硬终点（MACE），直接性高于单纯症状终点。
claims.uncertainty: 此为设计层面的结局定义，最终效应量以正式发表结果为准。

claims.claim: 该 24 周试验的安全性评估基于生命体征、实验室检查与不良事件；实验室检查包括血常规、尿常规、肝肾功能评估与心电图。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy and safety of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill in the treatment of stable angina (Qi stagnation and blood stasis syndrome): study protocol (Trials, 2021)
claims.supportQuote: Safety assessment will be based on vital signs, laboratory examinations, and adverse events … Laboratory measurements will include a routine blood and urine test, hepatorenal assessment, and electrocardiogram.
claims.applicability: 说明该长期试验纳入了肝肾功能监测，部分回应长期用药的肝肾安全性关注。
claims.uncertainty: 仅为方案规定的监测项目，尚未见其长期肝肾结局数据。

claims.claim: 4 周多中心、随机、双盲、安慰剂对照试验（174 例慢性冠脉综合征、硝酸酯不耐受患者）中，无受试者报告不良事件，速效救心丸组肝肾功能等实验室指标与安慰剂组差异无统计学意义。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy and Safety of Suxiao Jiuxin Pills in the Treatment of Chronic Coronary Syndrome with Intolerance to Adverse Effects of Long-acting Nitrates (BMC Complement Med Ther, 2024)
claims.supportQuote: A total of 174 CCS participants from eight clinical study centers in China were included in the modified intention-to-treat analyses … No participants reported experiencing adverse effects … Although the laboratory indicators in the SJPs group were higher than those in the placebo group, the differences did not reach statistical significance.
claims.applicability: 仅 4 周疗程，属短期安全性证据，不能外推至长期。
claims.uncertainty: 样本量有限、疗程短；未提供事件级分母与标准化归因。

claims.claim: 一项近期随机对照试验显示，24 周干预后速效救心丸改善稳定型心绞痛患者的躯体受限、心绞痛稳定性与治疗满意度。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy and Safety of Suxiao Jiuxin Pills in the Treatment of Chronic Coronary Syndrome with Intolerance to Adverse Effects of Long-acting Nitrates (BMC Complement Med Ther, 2024)
claims.supportQuote: a recent randomized clinical trial demonstrated that SJPs also effectively improved stable angina on physical limitations, angina stability, and treatment satisfaction, after 24 weeks of intervention
claims.applicability: 为 ≥3 个月（24 周）有效性提供一项随机对照试验层面的间接支持。
claims.uncertainty: 此为引述的第三方结论，非该 24 周试验原文的一手数据，效应量未经全文核对。

claims.claim: 4 周试验未对完成 4 周疗程后停药的患者进行长期随访——长期用药的持续获益与停药后转归缺乏直接证据。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy and Safety of Suxiao Jiuxin Pills in the Treatment of Chronic Coronary Syndrome with Intolerance to Adverse Effects of Long-acting Nitrates (BMC Complement Med Ther, 2024)
claims.supportQuote: we did not conduct a longer follow-up for patients who discontinued the treatment after completing a 4-week course
claims.applicability: 直接说明长期疗效证据缺口落在「缺长期随访」。
claims.uncertainty: 该研究作者明确承认的局限，属证据空白而非阴性结论。

claims.claim: 已发表临床研究显示速效救心丸缓解心绞痛症状且无严重不良反应，但因纳入研究方法学质量差，现有证据仍较弱。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy and safety of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill in the treatment of stable angina (Qi stagnation and blood stasis syndrome): study protocol (Trials, 2021)
claims.supportQuote: Several clinical researches on SJP have confirmed its efficacy in mitigating the symptoms of angina without any serious side effects … However, the evidence remains weak due to the poor methodological quality of included studies
claims.applicability: 支撑「短疗程疗效有初步证据但方法学质量差」的判断，构成长期证据确定性降级的理由之一。
claims.uncertainty: 表述来自试验方案背景部分，非系统评价的量化结果。

claims.claim: 24 周干预的随访时点设定为基线、4 周、12 周、24 周（各 ±数天）医院访视，及入组后 36 周电话随访。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy and safety of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill in the treatment of stable angina (Qi stagnation and blood stasis syndrome): study protocol (Trials, 2021)
claims.supportQuote: Intervention period (24 weeks): Baseline, medication for 4 weeks ± 2 days, medication for 12 weeks ± 3 days, medication for 24 weeks ± 5 days for hospital visits, and telephone follow-up for 36 weeks ± 7 days after enrolment.
claims.applicability: 说明该长期试验覆盖 4/12/24 周多个时点，可观察疗效随疗程的变化。
claims.uncertainty: 随访到 36 周（约 9 个月）为电话随访，非全部为面对面评估。
